changes: Native epoch boundaries1/6/11 now select the original three arrays per player epoch. World-owned decals retain source slot zero.
Urban/rural selection accepts the caller city query. The exact native CityManager geometry predicate is exported as nativeUrbanAt; ownership and minimap colour are never used as a substitute.
Thirteen explicit UndertextureSize/Offset bindings now use their source world dimensions independently of model normalization/gameplay raster size.
All declared physical frames are resident before rendering. Source seasonal list lengths1/4/5/12 and repeated filenames are preserved. The shared render calendar interpolates adjacent source images.
Every original PNG remains byte-identical; no new original installation dependency exists at runtime.

api.cityHelper: nativeUrbanAt(x,z,cities[{x,z,radius,active?}]) takes registered city-band radii in native world units. It does not invent those bands from renderer visibility.
api.textureUnits: DiffuseA0, Fog2, Height6, DiffuseB7. Every touched texture binding and prior program/VAO/buffer/blend/depth/flip state is restored.

limits: Exact native CityManager point membership is proved, but the renderer relies on the caller to supply the actual registered city bands. Full radius-registration/state/upgrade pipeline is not reconstructed by this module.
The original sprite-manager implementation and its complete seasonal blend/render-state pipeline remain outside this change; shared phase interpolation is a documented adapter.
Lighting, terrain grid projection and epsilon depth offset remain the existing adapters; no full native shader or pixel-perfect original-game comparison is claimed.
Death images are loaded and directly selectable, but the current simulation does not expose the complete native corpse/decal fade lifetime. Farm unresolved dimensions remain excluded.
GPU verification uses native offscreen EGL/GLES in Python. No browser, GUI or original game was opened; no physical macOS execution was tested.
